author: AsianPear
body: Hello. So it seems that there is not any set format to this, so I will do my best to include all information regarding my appeal (which will be quite a simple one.)<br id="null"><br id="null"><br id="null">I was banned for racking up many, many infractions and being immature. Following the path of those before me, I believe I have a shot at redemption and another chance. Rather than giving reasons that my actions were justified, I'd like to acknowledge that I was wrong and acted like a child. I apologize to all avicus staff members that have had to deal with me, and my wrongful actions. I shoul If there are any points I can expand further on, please don't hesitate to alert me. Like I said, I didn't see a format like there used to be. Thanks for reading this.<br id="null"><br id="null"><br id="null">If any of you would like to contact me further, my skype is Jacob.sandobal

replies.body: Well, since the person who banned you is no longer staff I am going to escalate this appeal and now only senior moderators may reply, good luck with your appeal!

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
Hey AsianPear
Since it's evident you have acknowledged your actions and have waited several months without evading. For this reason i will be appealing your infraction. Please note if you are banned again for excessive immaturity you have will have next to no chance of appealing.

Welcome back to Avicus!
Make sure you're updated with any rule changes avicus.net/rules <3
Infraction Appealed

~Pizza
